body: 20:15: Lane 7 (phone-calendar) reported failed with exit 0. All of its lib work is done and analyze is clean. Acceptance test 3 had a test-side bug that the hook locked: it looked for DayDetailPanel as a descendant of PhoneSheet, but Lane 4's DayDetailPanel builds the PhoneSheet (day_detail_panel.dart ~325). Handoff: handoff/proto-phone-shell-lane-7.md.U+000AU+000AU+002D I changed `find.descendant(` to `find.ancestor(` at test/features/calendar/phone_flower_month_test.dart ~545 in the run worktree (uncommitted). Analyze is clean and all 5 tests in the file pass.U+000AU+002D When this run exits, flip lanes["7"] to held exactly as for Lane 2, and add a note that the orchestrator applied the hook-locked fix. Then `run.zsh 1 --resume` lands Lane 7 and runs Lane 10, which depends on 7. Lanes 3, 8 and 9 do not depend on Lane 7 and continue in this run; Lane 8 started at 20:15.U+000AU+000AExisting tests outside every write-set that Lane 7 breaks, to add to the post-wave-1 fix-up after Lane 10 lands (they need Lane 7's code and Lane 10's states):U+000A1U+002E test/features/calendar/calendar_saturday_start_test.dart (1 test) and calendar_grid_parity_test.dart (5 of 6): add `theme: ThemeData(platform: TargetPlatform.macOS)` to each MaterialApp. The Worker verified this.U+000A2U+002E test/features/calendar/calendar_keyboard_test.dart (8 tests) uses shell_states' Android calendar states a4, a5 and a11 (calendarTitleKey, CalendarChevronButton, CalendarMonthPicker). The fix depends on what Lane 10 does to shell_states.dart. If those states stay Android, give `_pumpApp` a platform parameter and pass macOS from `_pumpCalendar`. If Lane 10 moves them to the phone flower month, the keyboard test needs macOS states of its own. In both cases, add the macOS theme to `_pumpJuly`.U+000A3U+002E test/accessibility/reading_order_test.dart (a5, a11, H1) and dark_walkthrough_test.dart ('Today, Calendar and its month picker…', 'a day view draws dark', android variant) are in no write-set. The phone now has phoneMonthPickerButtonKey and phoneMonthPreviousKey / phoneMonthNextKey, and labels 'Back to this month' and 'March 2026'. Recheck these after Lane 10.U+000AU+000AThe Worker ran `receipts doctor` (read-only). It reports receipts.config.json as stale: no version stamp, missing the agent and observe sections, a test command that no longer matches, and the app mistaken for a library. Re-running `receipts init --force` needs the owner's answers, so I'm leaving it.U+000AU+000AThe contrast finding is recorded as a risk for the owner.
